ideas.pitch: A practice and simulation platform tailored to the exact format of the QueryQuest SQL challenge to help solo competitors build muscle memory and speed under 100-minute time limits.
ideas.problem_statement: QueryQuest is a technical competition consisting of 10 questions (4 Basic, 3 Intermediate, 1 Advanced, 2 MCQs) within 100 minutes with a time-based tie-breaker.
ideas.title: QueryQuest Trainer & Speed-Drill Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the unique format and time constraints of the event by training competitors on speed and execution, matching the solo hacker format perfectly.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web utility that parses complex SQL queries written during competitive exams, instantly rendering execution plans and relational schemas to debug performance bottlenecks.
ideas.problem_statement: QueryQuest is designed to test participants' SQL knowledge, database concepts, and problem-solving abilities across various difficulty levels.
ideas.title: SQL Schema Visualizer & Execution Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on deep database concepts and query optimization, which separates top-ranking competitors in HackerRank-style SQL challenges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local testing harness that ingests custom table schemas and generates random edge-case test suites to thoroughly validate SQL queries before submission.
ideas.problem_statement: All submitted SQL solutions must satisfy the given problem requirements and test cases within the HackerRank platform constraints.
ideas.title: QueryLog: Automated SQL Problem Auto-Grader & Test Case Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the common pitfall of missing edge cases in SQL constraints (like NULL handling and joins) which cost crucial points in timed coding rounds.

ideas.pitch: A specialized review suite focused on database theory, indexing strategies, normalization, and advanced SQL multiple-choice questions.
ideas.problem_statement: The competition includes SQL Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) alongside practical coding problems.
ideas.title: SQL-Drill MCQ and Conceptual Concept Flashcards
ideas.why_it_could_win: Competitors often neglect the MCQ component, making a high score on theory questions the differentiator for podium placements.

ideas.pitch: A tool that tracks time spent per question during practice runs, highlighting where competitors lose time across basic, intermediate, and advanced tiers.
ideas.problem_statement: If two or more participants achieve the same score, the participant who completes the assessment in the shortest time will be ranked higher.
ideas.title: SpeedQuery Analytics: Post-Assessment Performance Replay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the time-based tie-breaker rule by offering actionable analytics on question pacing and bottlenecks.
